generated_delivery.note: Before is the baseline committed Skill ZIP/resources; after is the generated same-build output. Shared is fully included in each current event, so default legacy contract grows while entry/selected workflows and total bundle shrink; navigation does not expand other events.

baseline_contract_direct_continuations.scope: 旧默认 Contract 加其显式要求直接读取的政策片段，按实际返回字符与字节相加；不展开间接续读、不去重。条件性未来动作读取并非全部立即必需，因此不作为等范围最小交付声明。

generated_delivery_measurements.scope: 实际交付正文计数；当前 contract 包含共享契约与任务事件，不把旧默认片段当作等范围基线。Skill 入口包含构建页脚。历史直接续读测量保持原始口径，不据此推断 Token、成本或运行性能。
